subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Service Level Agreements
description: Learn Service Level Agreements in one minute.

hook.text: The SLA says 98% on-time delivery. The supplier delivers 91%. Without the SLA, there's no recourse.

buildup.text: Service level agreements define measurable performance expectations: delivery time, quality, and response speed.

discovery.text: They include targets, measurement methods, reporting schedules, and consequences for missing benchmarks.

twist.text: An SLA without enforcement is just a wish list. Penalties, bonuses, or exit clauses give it teeth.

climax.text: Well-structured SLAs improve supplier performance by 15–20% because what gets measured gets managed.

punchline.text: Define the standard. Measure it. Enforce it.
